purpose: Traceable manual-review register for bridge and complex-intersection geometry. An entry is not field-verified unless its status and evidence say so.

status_policy.inventory_pending: Named by project scope, but exact geometry/OSM objects are not yet inventoried.
status_policy.requires_manual_review: Located in the imported network, but lanes, movements or levels are not confirmed.
status_policy.modelled_assumption: A local model exists, using explicitly documented non-survey assumptions.
status_policy.verified_geometry: Geometry was checked against a dated declared source; not a claim of engineering certification.

entries.title: Иманова — мост Беласар: два проезда по две полосы

scene_layers.notes: Two one-way carriageways, two lanes each; part of the SUMO transport network.

Candidate lower service-road sequence. Way 622653202 is explicitly highway=service, covered=yes, layer=-1; adjacent service ways require topology review. Do not connect it to the upper bridge without a legal SUMO movement.
Reported pedestrian/parking area under the bridge. It is a 3D context layer, not a SUMO vehicle lane; exact OSM parking/pedestrian polygons still require identification.

evidence: Project requirement: preserve two lanes in each direction and avoid artificial narrowing at both ends.

Current OSM inventory locates adjacent Belasar bridge carriageways 1537667048 and 846023745. Each is highway=secondary, bridge=yes, oneway=yes, lanes=2 and connects to Imanov approaches in the compiled SUMO network.
open_questions: Determine the full upper/lower-road elevation profile: a provisional 6.5 m deck produced an invalid 99% grade on a short approach, so no height is currently applied.
Confirm lane marking and allowed turns from an independent current source before declaring verified geometry.
